name: com.sansfiction/catalog
description: Search the SansFiction book catalog and manage a personal reading library (books, collections, reading progress, ratings, stats). Public catalog is open; personal library requires a bearer token.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> (sf_mcp_...) for personal-library tools; omit for public catalog access. Generate a token at https://sansfiction.com/docs/agents
